description: Sentences in the positions of an expression's value, each printed and drawn under the values that take it (measured on Angular 22.2.1 through JIT and a render in jsdom): each branch of a conditional, the right of `&&`, either side of a concatenation, the right of `??` and of `||`. Point 3 reads no literal in a position that cannot be the value — a comparison's operand, a condition, the left of `&&` — and a read that took one of these for such a position lost a refusal, so the case counts seven.
